title: bench_multi duplicate_research prints one line per research key the owner holds on the article, so one duplicate fact counts several times
goal: One duplicate fact pair gives one duplicate-research line however many live keys its owner holds on that article, and the check_failures count and the N duplicate research text count duplicate facts. Found by the SP-n7f53pgv review (S3 on ST-f5lbn3aw).

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import bench_multi as B, coord
B.origin_path=lambda root:'bare'; B.agent_email=lambda n:'a%d@example.com'%n
terms=['batch size','page limit','retry delay']
keys=['research:public/x/y:'+coord.term_id(t,60) for t in terms]
B.claim_windows=lambda store:[(k,'multi-agent1',90.0,200.0) for k in keys]
def run(f1,f2,real=True):
    def af(bare,base,email):
        t=f1 if email[1]=='1' else f2
        return [{'path':'public/x/y.md','text':t,'at':100.0,'ids':['S1'],'doc':['S1']}]
    B.added_facts=af
    return B.duplicate_research('root',{'base':'b','agents':[{'coord_store':'s'}]},[{'n':1,'agent':'agent-1'},{'n':2,'agent':'agent-2'}])
same=run('Exports send 512 records in each request. [DOC S1]','Exports send 512 records in each request call. [DOC S1]')
print('same fact, owner holds 3 keys ->',len(same),'lines')
diff=run('Exports send 512 records in each request. [DOC S1]','Retry delay doubles after every failed upload attempt. [DOC S1]')
